name: Takashima (Shiga, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takashima city emblem in navy: a stylised flower of five drop-shaped petals.
history: Municipal flag of Takashima, a city in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 2005.

features.role: Takashima city emblem — a stylised flower of five drop-shaped petals
